description: Header file for DSA sample implementation in Zephyr RTOS, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes for network interface handling, socket communication, and thread management related to DSA (Distributed Switch Architecture) functionality.

methods.name: check_ll_ether_addr
methods.description: Checks if two Ethernet addresses are identical.

methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value in big-endian format into a buffer.

methods.name: start_slave_port_packet_socket
